subject: prd/impl-review
statement: If a canonical git event append or linked pass/aggregate proposal-projection write fails, then the system shall retry to a bounded cap, persist any available non-accepting integrity signal without treating it as replacement evidence, and refuse acceptance until both FR-27 faces are complete and losslessly consistent
intent: delayed evidence or named persistence failure, never silent loss
fit_criterion: git, both media, and face-mismatch failures converge or block; no satisfying result exists without the complete immutable event chain and byte-faithful linked projection
